chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Natana (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us from his father, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:
The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said: The Shi'a of Ali are the triumphant on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْفَائِزُونَ: The triumphant, the successful, the ones who attain salvation — derived from fawz (ultimate success/salvation)
key_terms.شِيعَةُ: Followers, partisans — those who support and adhere to the guidance of Imam Ali and his progeny

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the Shi'a of Ali on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the golden chain of Imam al-Rida (as) and his forefathers back to the Prophet (saww), contains a prophetic declaration affirming that the followers (Shi'a) of Imam Ali (as) will be the victorious and successful ones on the Day of Judgment. The word 'Shi'a' here refers to the true followers and partisans of Imam Ali who adhere to his guidance and the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt. This narration appears in al-Saduq's Amali (368 AH) as part of a series of ahadith narrated by al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, a trusted companion of Imam al-Rida known for transmitting important traditions from the Imam.
